title: Quantifier-Shift Fallacy
description: A fallacy of reversing the order of two quantifiers.
logical_form:
Every X has a related Y.

Therefore, there is some Y related to every X.

examples.example:
Everybody has a mother.

Therefore, there is some woman out there who is the mother of us all.
examples.explanation: While it is true that everyone has (or had) a mother, the term “mother” is not a singular term that is shared -- it is implied that it is a category in which many mothers reside.  The conclusion is asserting the opposite of the meaning -- that there is actually just one mother shared by everyone.  This form of reasoning is invalid; therefore, fallacious.

examples.example:
Everybody has a brain.

Therefore, there is a single brain we all share.
examples.explanation: Everybody has *his or her own* brain, not one we all share.  Although I have met many people who seem not to have their own brain.  This form of reasoning is invalid; therefore, fallacious.

tips: Remember that a quantifier is an expression (e.g. all, some) that indicates the scope of a term to which it is attached.
references: Cook, R. T. (2009). *A Dictionary of Philosophical Logic*. Edinburgh University Press.
logical_form_et:
Igal X-l on seotud Y.

Seetõttu on iga X-ga seotud mingi Y.
tips_et: Pidage meeles, et kvantor on avaldis (nt kõik, mõned), mis näitab selle termini ulatust, millega see on seotud.

examples_et.example:
Kõigil on ema.

Seetõttu on seal mõni naine, kes on meie kõigi ema.
examples_et.explanation: Kuigi on tõsi, et igaühel on (või oli) ema, ei ole mõiste "ema" ainsus, mida jagatakse – see on kategooria, milles elavad paljud emad.  Järeldus kinnitab tähenduse vastupidist - et tegelikult on kõigil ainult üks ema.  Selline arutlusviis on kehtetu; seega ekslik.

The conclusion is asserting the opposite of the meaning -- that there is actually just one mother shared by everyone.  This form of reasoning is invalid; therefore, fallacious.

examples_et.example:
Kõigil on aju.

Seetõttu on meil kõigil üks aju.
examples_et.explanation: Kõigil on *oma* aju, mitte aju, mida me kõik jagame.  Kuigi olen kohanud paljusid inimesi, kellel ei paista oma aju olevat.  Selline arutlusviis on kehtetu; seega ekslik.
